cases.descripcion: Misma consultora, dos avisos QA con el mismo título base y el área en el paréntesis. normalizeTitle tira el paréntesis y los dos quedan en 'quality engineering' (Jaccard 1). Se fusionaron y el JD más largo pisó al otro.

a.title: Senior Quality Engineering (Loyalty & Benefits, Manual/API Testing)
a.jd: This is the job: In the Banking & Financial Services industry, we are actively seeking a Senior Quality Engineering (Manual/API Testing) to join our team dedicated to testing the bank's Loyalty & Benefits module: business rules, point accumulation and tier transitions for web and mobile channels. This is you: Bachelor's degree or advanced student in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields. Proven experience in API testing using Postman. Solid experience designing and executing manual test cases using Xray Test Management and managing defect lifecycles in JIRA. Hands-on experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, Kanban). This is your role: Validate point accumulation, rule execution, and tier level transitions across incoming banking transactions. Conduct functional testing within the Salesforce platform context. Locations: Buenos Aires. Remote status: Hybrid. Technology: QA. Seniority: Senior-level.

b.title: Senior Quality Engineering (Biometric)
b.jd: This is the job: In the Banking & Financial Services industry, we are actively seeking a Senior Quality Engineering (Biometric) to join our team dedicated to ensuring the quality and security of the bank's biometric platform and digital onboarding solutions: capture SDKs, liveness detection and document verification (OCR). This is you: Bachelor's degree or advanced student in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields. 3+ years of software quality assurance experience specializing in biometric identity verification systems. Proven experience managing and executing test cases with Xray Test Management and managing defect lifecycles in JIRA. Hands-on experience working with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban). This is your role: Design and execute test suites for biometric rule engines. Conduct Liveness and Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) testing. Monitor biometric metrics (FAR, FRR, EER). Locations: Buenos Aires. Technology: QA. Seniority: Senior-level.

Build and optimize the core reasoning and execution layers of the autonomous agent platform.
